whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Leather Care for Your Leather Handbags?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Leather is skin: it needs its oils to stay supple, and it marks with water. Here is why professional leather care is worth it:

points.title: No Cracking
points.desc: The wrong solvent or heat dries leather out until it cracks. We use leather-specific products only.

points.title: Stays Supple
points.desc: Conditioning puts back the oils that daily wear and dry air take out.

points.title: Colour Protected
points.desc: Surface cleaning lifts grime without stripping the finish or dye.

points.title: Water-Mark Safe
points.desc: Leather is never soaked, so it does not dry stiff or ringed.

points.title: Hardware Cared For
points.desc: Zips, studs and buckles are cleaned and checked alongside the leather.

points.title: Lining Freshened
points.desc: The lining is freshened so the piece smells clean inside as well as out.
